name: Asset Alchemist
delivery: GitHub Pages static app, no installer
compatibility: Same Discord OPEN ASSET ALCHEMIST URL and existing iPhone home-screen web app; all existing studios intact
privacy: All media chosen by user stays within current device/browser IndexedDB; no server upload or GitHub artifact publishing of private files
features: Regular GIF with automatic aspect ratio
GIF imported and transcoded without Chromium ImageDecoder
Optional full-screen GIF or muted MP4/WebM background
Media persists locally with user clear controls
Animation Forge and Packager can apply generated GIF/media
known_limits: GIF output is inherently silent and palette-limited
Video decoding and mobile autoplay depend on browser and codecs; videos are always muted, looped and inline
GIF exports are bounded by 8 seconds, 96 frames, 720 px each side and 360,000 total pixels
Media uploads stay in local browser storage (not synced between iPhone and desktop); site-data deletion removes settings
GIF source frame compositing requires source that fits browser memory limits
validation: Automated JS/source checks, GIF round-trip + GIF fallback tests; live deployment/mobile browser testing is separate
